technical.title: InstantHMR enables real-time 3D human mesh recovery on mobile devices.
technical.summary: InstantHMR is a family of open-source single-image regressors built for mobile inference, achieving 3D human mesh recovery in 5.5 ms on a Samsung Galaxy S23 NPU.
technical.why: It brings high-performance computer vision capabilities directly to resource-constrained mobile hardware.

technical.title: New VLM-driven agentic framework optimizes selective cooperative perception in traffic.
technical.summary: This study proposes a VLM-driven agentic framework for blind spot reasoning and dialogue-based cooperative perception to improve scalability and resource efficiency in multi-agent traffic environments.
technical.why: It directly impacts autonomous driving architectures by reducing communication overhead.

technical.title: REINS explores a self-evolving agent harness for real-time trajectory planning.
technical.summary: This research addresses the lack of runtime agent harnesses in trajectory planning, tackling millisecond-level control constraints and the need for verification loops in autonomous driving.
technical.why: It bridges the gap between LLM agent paradigms and real-time autonomous driving constraints.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is available on SageMaker JumpStart.
technical.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter multimodal vision-language model, is now available for deployment in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart for document and agentic workloads.
technical.why: It provides engineers with easy access to a powerful new VLM for enterprise applications.

technical.title: Agibot introduces an open-source modular swerve-drive robot platform.
technical.summary: Agibot is a low-cost, open-source agricultural robotics platform featuring independent swerve drive, swappable computing, and multimodal sensing designed for autonomy research.
technical.why: It provides a practical hardware platform for robotics engineers and researchers.

technical.title: Video-DCI benchmark evaluates VLM agents in direct video-corpus interaction.
technical.summary: Video-DCI is a diagnostic benchmark and human-agent protocol featuring DCI-Loc and DCI-QA tasks to evaluate multi-round visual evidence seeking and cross-video reasoning in VLM agents.
technical.why: It provides a rigorous way to evaluate complex video understanding capabilities in agents.

technical.title: SkinMind introduces agentic RAG with graph probing for reliable dermatology AI.
technical.summary: SkinMind is a multimodal agentic RAG framework that uses human-inspired graph probing and hierarchical tools for autonomous evidence seeking across textual and visual sources in dermatology.
technical.why: It offers an advanced architectural pattern for medical multimodal retrieval tasks.

technical.title: SD-ViT proposes stochastic deep supervision for gallery-consistent early-exit face recognition.
technical.summary: SD-ViT is a training framework that enables usable exits at every block depth in Vision Transformers by adding a stochastic auxiliary signal to intermediate layers.
technical.why: This improves efficiency and flexibility for deploying Vision Transformers in resource-constrained settings.

technical.title: HippoMamba uses Mamba blocks for hippocampal segmentation in Alzheimer's disease.
technical.summary: HippoMamba combines a 3D convolutional encoder-decoder with a Mamba selective state space block to process serial MRI visits, achieving high segmentation accuracy for Alzheimer's research.
technical.why: It showcases the growing utility of state-space models in medical computer vision.

technical.title: Reason Machines open-sources Aspen, a Git server built for AI agents.
technical.summary: Reason Machines has released Aspen, a self-hosted Git server designed for AI agents that handles high volumes of concurrent pushes based on OpenAI's Pando design.
technical.why: It offers infrastructure tooling tailored to multi-agent software development workflows.

business.summary: Huang told Nvidia staff in an email that he had an affair and that the company's board has opened an investigation into allegations the woman is a Chinese spy.

business.summary: SoftBank Group announces fiscal second-quarter results for the year ending March 31, 2027.

business.summary: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.

business.summary: Anthropic bought billions of dollars' worth of natural gas turbines in a deal that could give it buyer's remorse.

business.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering could be a crucial test of investor confidence in the AI trade, CNBC's Jim Cramer said.

business.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
business.summary: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.

models.title: Idol Turns Single Images into 3D Gaussian Splats
models.summary: Idol converts a single picture, render, or generated image into a 3D Gaussian splat containing up to a million Gaussians, filling in unseen sides and removing backgrounds. It runs on consumer GPUs in under two seconds using 7.2 GB of VRAM.
models.why: It enables rapid single-image 3D asset generation directly on consumer hardware.

models.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Released as a Multimodal Agentic Model
models.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal 2.8T Mixture-of-Experts model featuring 104B activated parameters and a 1-million-token context window. It improves significantly in coding, 3D creation, financial research, and agentic capabilities.
models.why: Offers massive context and advanced agentic capabilities for multimodal engineering tasks.

models.title: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder Explores Small Language Model 3D Generation
models.summary: CCORE released an early preview of Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder, an independent fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B focused on general-purpose coding and high-quality interactive 3D scene generation using Three.js.
models.why: Tests the feasibility of small language models for specialized 3D scene creation.

models.title: Ripple-65B Preview Dense Transformer Released with 1M Context
models.summary: Ricursive Intelligence introduced Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B parameter dense Transformer model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1 million context tokens. It scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1.
models.why: Delivers high-performance agentic coding capabilities from an open-weight dense model.

models.title: Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable Released with Reduced Thinking Tokens
models.summary: This fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B drastically reduces thinking tokens by half to one-tenth while maintaining output quality. It exceeds 730 arc-c and 880 ARC-E scores, shipping in GGUF quants with MTP Neo-CODER MAX support.
models.why: Significantly accelerates inference output generation speed for a mid-sized model.

models.title: Qwen3.8-27B Model Weights and Configuration Files Released
models.summary: Qwen has released model weights and configuration files for Qwen3.8-27B, compatible with Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang. A hosted API service with a default 1M context length is coming soon.
models.why: Provides raw model weights for deploying a mid-sized foundation model locally or via inference engines.
